references.text: The Lord promises to give rain at the right time, both autumn and spring rain, so that the people can gather grain, wine, and oil.
The Lord will open His rich storehouse, the heavens, to give the land rain at the right time and bless all their work.
The Lord promises blessing rain at the right time, and the trees shall bear fruit and the earth yield its produce.
Joel prophesies that the Lord will send autumn and spring rain, and the threshing floors shall be filled with grain.
The psalm praises that the earth has yielded its produce, and God blesses His people.
The Lord will give what is good, and the land shall yield its produce.
Isaiah prophesies that the Lord will give rain for the seed and bread from the fruit of the ground.
Zechariah speaks of the seed of peace, that the vine shall yield its fruit and the earth its produce, and the heavens their dew.
The land shall yield its fruit so that the people may eat their fill and dwell securely.
James uses the image of the farmer waiting for the precious fruit of the earth, waiting patiently for the autumn and spring rain.
